title: In Vitro PMEL-1 T Cell-Mediated Cytotoxicity Assay
author: Elinor Gottschalk
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6j4hcqw

steps.title: Plate Target Cells
steps.instruction: Plate target cancer cells in a 96 well plate at 25,000 cells per well in DMEM with 10% FBS.

substeps.instruction: Plate target cells in columns 2-7.
Leave the remaining wells empty.
Use 6 replicates per column.
Prepare at least two plates: one for peptide-pulsed target cells and one for unpulsed cells as a negative control.
Incubate target cells overnight to allow adherence.

steps.title: Pulse Target Cells
steps.instruction: If required, pulse the target cells in one plate with 1 uM hgp100 peptide for 1 hour at 37 °C.

substeps.instruction: Wash the peptide out 3 times with T cell media.

steps.title: Prepare T Cells
steps.instruction: Prepare T cells for co-culture by centrifuging and resuspending.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge T cells at 350 x g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend in T cell media supplemented with IL-2 (200IU/ml) to a concentration of 2 million cells per ml.

steps.title: Co-culture T Cells with Target Cells
steps.instruction: Combine T cells and target cells in the 96 well plate.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate culture media from the 96 well plate.
Pipette 100 µL T cell media into columns 3-7 and 9-12 (leave columns 2 and 8 empty).
Pipette 100 µL of T cell suspension into columns 2, 3, 8, and 9.

steps.title: Perform Serial Dilution of T Cells
steps.instruction: Perform serial dilutions of T cells within the plate to create different concentrations.

substeps.instruction: In column 3 (total volume 200 µL), pipette up and down 3 times to mix, then transfer 100 µL to column 4.
Mix column 4 by pipetting up and down, then transfer 100 µL to column 5.
Mix column 5 by pipetting up and down, then remove and discard 100 µL.
Repeat the same dilution process starting at column 9 to create T cell dilutions without cancer cells.

steps.title: Prepare CytoTox-ONE Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the CytoTox-ONE Homogenous Membrane Integrity Assay (Promega Catalog #G7890) reagents.

substeps.instruction: Thaw assay buffer and stop solution and bring to room temperature.
Thaw lysis solution and prepare a 1:5 dilution in PBS (e.g., 20 µL lysis solution + 80 µL PBS for a total volume of 100 µL per plate).

steps.title: Lyse Control Cells
steps.instruction: Lyse cells in the maximum LDH release control wells immediately after removing plates from the incubator.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 µL diluted lysis solution to each well in column 7.
Mix the lysis buffer into the well by pipetting up and down.

steps.title: Equilibrate Plates
steps.instruction: Allow plates to sit in the hood for 30 minutes to equilibrate to room temperature.

steps.title: Perform Membrane Integrity Assay
steps.instruction: Execute the CytoTox-ONE assay to measure LDH release.

substeps.instruction: Add 11 ml Assay Buffer into one substrate bottle and mix.
Pour the assay buffer/substrate mixture into a reagent reservoir and use a multichannel pipette to add 100 µL into each well.
Shake the plate gently to mix.
Cover from light in the hood and incubate for 10 minutes.
Add 50 µL stop solution to each well in the same order as the assay buffer was added and shake gently to mix.

steps.title: Read Plates
steps.instruction: Read plates on a fluorescence plate reader using excitation 560 and emission 590 in the order they were prepared.

steps.title: Calculate Percent Cytotoxicity
steps.instruction: Calculate percent cytotoxicity using the formula: ((experimental-CMB)-(Tcellbackground-CMB)/(maxLDHrelease-CMB))X 100.

substeps.instruction: Experimental: co-culture wells (columns 2-6).
CMB (culture medium background): culture media with no cells (column 12).
T cell background: T cells only at concentrations corresponding to co-culture ratios (columns 8-11).
Max LDH release: MC38 cells lysed with detergent (column 7).
